title: Influence of "Likes" in Social Media Food Ads on Black and White Adolescents' Food Purchases - Study 2
official: A Randomized Trial to Examine the Influence of "Likes" in Social Media Food Ads on Black and White Adolescents' Food Purchases - Study 2
summary: This is a randomized trial to examine the influence of number of "likes"on social media food ads on Black and White adolescents' food purchases
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adolescent (13-17 years of age) who identifies as only non-Latino White or only Black/African American; who logs into Instagram once daily; who can read and speak English

Exclusion Criteria:

\- participants who do not meet all criteria described above.
